_what: THE PROOF that --heldout-gate REACHES AND PASSES its probe on the REAL v5 config + REAL v5 caches. Before the 2026-07-27 wiring this raised ValueError: cond_vtarget is on but no vt_band supplied at the FIRST probe.
command: launch_smoke2.sh's real v5 config with --heldout-every 20 --steps 65 --heldout-episodes 4 --heldout-nboot 400 --heldout-goal dropped
GOAL_OPTION_is_an_AGENTS_default: 'dropped' chosen by the vtband-WIRING stream, PENDING THE PI's OVERRIDE. --heldout-goal band0|produced flips it; nothing else changes.
_why_not_quotable: a from-scratch model at steps 20/40/60 inside the lambda_plan Phase-B ramp. What is proved here is that the gate RUNS, SCORES, forms a composite, pins its admitted components, renders a paired interval and executes the STOP PATH - not that any of these numbers describe model quality.

outcome.EARLY_STOP_line: {"EARLY_STOP": true, "step": 60, "reason": "...separated-WORSE than the incumbent (step 20) for 2 consecutive probes (patience=2); last delta -0.1377 [-0.2121, -0.0572], paired_episode_cluster_bootstrap, n_episodes=4..."}
outcome.NOTE_the_decline_is_NOT_an_injected_degr: this stop was caused by real early-training dynamics under the Phase-B ramp; its DIRECTION was not pre-verified, so it is evidence that the STOP PATH EXECUTES end-to-end, NOT that the gate discriminates a decayed model. The direction-verified degradation proof is gate_stop_proof_v4fs15k.json.

grid.lateral_refusal: The LATERAL grid axis is REFUSED on MEASURED geometry. The flat-road homography's relative displacement error is exactly height_above_road / h_cam (depth-free, |dlat|-free, f-free): 100 % at the camera height, SIGN-INVERTED above it, and 50 % of the frame at pitch 0 is above the horizon where the ground plane has no preimage. At |dlat| = 2.0 m only 28.3 % of in-frame points meet the pre-registered rel_err < 0.25 bar (required: 95 %). Artifact: TanitAD Research Hub/Benchmarks & Eval/Implementation/incoming/2026-07-27-pseudo-simulation/artifacts/lat_warp_fidelity.json (outcome L-BAD). The YAW axis passes the identical test at max error 0.0 px, so the test is not vacuous.
unwarped_axes: longitudinal (real frames at an index offset)

envelope.provenance: P1 MEASURED (lowood_flagship_ci.json), on the flagship v1 arm — NOT on v4

envelope_proof.EXTRAPOLATION_VERDICT: MEASUREMENT — every step stayed inside the MEASURED envelope
envelope_proof.why_zero_by_construction: Deviation is the GRID, not an accumulated rollout state. The protocol has no mechanism by which a window can drift outside the envelope, because no window ever advances.

falsifier._what: the assertion CAN fail; these are the values that fail it
falsifier.example: GridSpec(dyaw_deg=(12.5,)) raises EnvelopeViolation; it is exercised in taniteval/tests/test_pseudosim.py.

pseudosim.estimator: paired episode-cluster bootstrap (B=400, unit = held-out episode)

surface.goal_option_meaning: vt_band=VT_DROPPED(23), route=ROUTE_DROPPED(4), route_graded=0.0. The probe measures the deployed NO-GOAL surface, on the embedding rows goal_dropout=0.5 trains on ~50 % of every batch. The longitudinal selection term is masked OFF (vt_keep=False).

warp.falsifier: any frame tensor whose trailing (H, W) differs from the declared frame, or a non-256x256 raster with no frame declared at all
